description: This header defines the 'Config' class within the Thunder::PluginHost namespace, including nested classes for configuration management, path substitution, and server setup. It manages various server parameters, paths, security, and plugin configurations for the Thunder framework.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Main configuration class for server setup, paths, security, and plugin management within Thunder framework.

classes.name: Config::Substituter
classes.description: Handles variable substitution in configuration paths using delimiters and a variable map.

classes.name: Config::JSONConfig
classes.description: JSON-based container for server configuration parameters, including process, input, observables, and optional Hibernate settings.

classes.name: Config::JSONConfig::ProcessSet
classes.description: Defines process-related configuration such as user, group, priority, and thread pool settings.

classes.name: Config::JSONConfig::InputConfig
classes.description: Defines input handler configuration including locator, type, and output enablement.

classes.name: Config::JSONConfig::Observables
classes.description: Contains paths for proxy stub and plugin configuration.

classes.name: Config::JSONConfig::HibernateConfig
classes.description: Optional Hibernate server configuration with locator address.

classes.name: Config::InputInfo
classes.description: Encapsulates input handler details such as locator, type, and enabled status.

classes.name: Config::ProcessInfo
classes.description: Encapsulates process parameters like user, group, priority, OOM adjustment, policy, and UMask.

methods.name: Substituter::Substitute
methods.description: Performs variable substitution within input strings based on delimiters and variable map.

methods.name: Config::SetPrefix
methods.description: Sets the server prefix and updates the web prefix accordingly.

methods.name: Config::UpdateBinder
methods.description: Resolves and updates the network binder address based on configuration.

methods.name: Config::UpdateAccessor
methods.description: Resolves and updates the server accessor URL based on network configuration.
